Perfect Roast Potatoes
By: Emily Martin
Published: Sunday, March 7, 2010 - 10:58pm

Ingredients




4 pounds Potatoes, peeled
4 ounces Lard or sunflower oil
1 tablespoon Flour
1 teaspoon Mustard powder
Coarse sea salt

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 200'C (400'F). If the potatoes are very large cut them in half. Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil, then add the potatoes and cook for10 mins. Meanwhile, put the lard in a large roasting tin. Put in the oven for 10 mins until the fat is sizzling hot. Drain the potatoes and return to the pan. Cover the pan and shake vigorously to roughen the outside of all the potatoes. Sprinkle the flour and mustard over the potatoes and shake the pan again.
